name: Tougi Seiichirou
source:
Seiichirou is the treasurer of the student council, along with his sister [url=/c1189]Shiro[/url]. He is very kind with his sister, and may have a sister complex. He used to be the president of the Japanese archery club.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fortune_Arterial]Wikipedia[/url].]
